name: Assassin's Roost
title: Assassin's Roost
summary: A 78 m Empyrean lighthouse tower (28 m base, z 64-142) on a conical mound (z 32-64) in the middle of the north-east crater of the South Direlands Craters (73.9S 43.7W), the headquarters of Selaina the Subtle and Creed; it can only be entered through its quest, but the surface tower is freely visible.

site.name: Assassin's Roost
site.notes: Derived teleport on the crater floor 78 m west-south-west of the tower, 7 m from the nearest rock.

shots.standingOrder: Climb slowly round the 78 m lighthouse tower in the crater, 48 to 62 m out, climbing from 20 m to 52 m up its 78 m shaft with the sun behind; keep 30 m from the tower.
shots.notes: Signature helix around the 78 m Empyrean lighthouse in the crater: radius 48 -> 62 m, climbing from 20 to 52 m above its mound, 0.14 turn from south toward south-west, the crater rim wheeling behind; sun behind. shots.standingOrder: Dolly back across the crater floor from the tower while zooming in so the lighthouse holds its size and the crater rim swells behind it; keep 4 m above the ground.
